name: Dodavahu
title: The Prophet from Maresha
summary: Dodavahu, whose father is not named in the text, was from Maresha and is mentioned only once in the Bible. He was the father of the prophet Eliezer, who prophesied against King Jehoshaphat of Judah because of his alliance with the wicked King Ahaziah of Israel. Dodavahu is known primarily through his son's prophetic ministry.

keyEvents.title: Dodavahu's Son Prophesies Against Jehoshaphat
keyEvents.description: Eliezer, son of Dodavahu from Maresha, prophesied against King Jehoshaphat because he had allied himself with King Ahaziah of Israel. The prophecy foretold the destruction of the ships that Jehoshaphat had built.

keyEvents.title: Jehoshaphat's Failed Trading Fleet
keyEvents.description: As a result of the prophecy, the ships that Jehoshaphat had built in Ezion-Geber to sail to Tarshish were destroyed and never completed their journey.

keyEvents.title: Jehoshaphat's Alliance with Ahaziah
keyEvents.description: King Jehoshaphat of Judah made an alliance with the wicked King Ahaziah of Israel to build trading ships, which led to God's judgment through Eliezer, son of Dodavahu.

keyEvents.title: Dodavahu's Hometown Maresha
keyEvents.description: They added a man from Mareshah, an important city in Judah that was also the hometown of the prophet Micah. The city was located in the lowlands of southern Judah and had strategic significance.
